title: BNCI 2025-001 Motor Kinematics Reaching dataset
description: A preprocessed electroencephalography dataset from 20 healthy participants performing a four-direction center-out reaching task with varying speeds and distances under visual cueing. The dataset comprises 960 trials across 16 motor imagery classes, recorded at 500 Hz using a 67-channel BrainAmp system with extensive preprocessing including eye artifact correction, ICA, and common average referencing. This resource supports brain-computer interface research and motor imagery classification studies.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 500 Hz using a 67-channel BrainAmp system (Zebris ELPOS cap) with 4 EOG channels. Participants performed a cue-paced discrete reaching task with four directions (up, down, left, right), two speeds (slow, fast), and two distances (near, far), yielding 16 classes. Preprocessing included low-pass filtering (100 Hz), 50 Hz notch filtering, downsampling to 200 Hz, bad channel rejection and interpolation, bandpass filtering (0.3-80 Hz), eye artifact correction via SGEYESUB, ICA with FastICA, IC artifact removal, and common average reference. Final analysis used 55 channels after frontal and EOG channel removal.
